description: Defines classes and functions for Windows UDP socket operations, including socket creation, connection, binding, multicast, DSCP settings, and integration with Windows-specific APIs like QWAVE and overlapped IO.

classes.name: QwaveApi
classes.description: Encapsulates Windows QWAVE API functions for setting packet priorities and flow management.

classes.name: DscpManager
classes.description: Manages DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) settings per remote endpoint using QWAVE flows.

classes.name: UDPSocketWin
classes.description: Implements Windows-specific UDP socket operations, including socket creation, connection, multicast, buffer management, and overlapped IO.

methods.name: QwaveApi::GetDefault
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of QwaveApi.

methods.name: DscpManager::Set
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for the socket, updating the QWAVE flow accordingly.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Open
methods.description: Creates and opens a UDP socket with specified address family.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specified local address.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Connect
methods.description: Connects the socket to a remote address.

methods.name: UDPSocketWin::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket and releases resources.
